rewriters.name: checkSelectEquiv
rewriters.note: decision procedure; proved results carry SelectEquiv (≃ₛ, every database); WHERE case lifted from checkEquivFull via select_where_congr

rewriters.name: checkQueryEquiv
rewriters.note: decision procedure; proved results carry QueryEquiv (≃ᵩ, every database); .simple via checkSelectEquiv, .compound congruence

rewriters.name: decideClosedExprEquivInst
rewriters.note: Decidable (≃ₑ) for closed expressions only (isClosed); see also decideGroundExprEquiv_sound_closed

relation.name: ExprEquiv (≃ₑ)
relation.equality: Lean propositional equality on Option Value: kind-strict (distinct Value constructors never coincide); rewrite patterns match constructors, so host-language equality confusion cannot arise
weakerVariantsToReject: ExprEquivEmptyDb (≃ₑ₀): empty database only. Known, correctly labelled users: decideGroundExprEquivInst and decideGroundExprEquiv_sound decide ≃ₑ₀ for ground expressions and must not be used to conclude ≃ₑ

projectSpecificChecks: checkEquivFull may conclude ≃ₑ from ground evaluation only when both sides are Expr.isClosed; Expr.isGround admits database-dependent EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t)
Dialect operators (BinOp.likeCI, MIN/MAX modes) must not be matched by rewrite arms whose proofs cover only the default operator
When a Value constructor is added, the LSpec generators and tools/definition_coverage_matrix.py must learn it in the same PR (CLAUDE.md)

No partial def, unsafe, implemented_by, extern or native_decide may be reachable from the evaluator, a rewriter, a tactic or a checker (#278); the remaining partial defs (58 on 17 Nov 2026; count with grep -rnE "^\s*(private |protected )?partial def" SqlEquiv/, since a plain grep also matches comments) are only in Parser.lean, Pretty.lean and toReprStr. Test/TrustBaseTest.lean (#assert_no_runtime_overrides) and Test/TacticTest.lean (#guard_msgs on axioms) enforce this
The LSpec probe exercises only expression rewriters; statement checkers (checkSelectEquiv, checkQueryEquiv) rely on their kernel-checked proofs and the smoke tests in StatementChecker.lean
